import json,time,os
from pathlib import Path
for sample in range(2):
 rows=[]
 for t in sorted(Path('/proc/1/task').iterdir()):
  try:
   stat=(t/'stat').read_text();v=stat[stat.rfind(')')+2:].split()
   rows.append([int(t.name),v[0],int(v[11]),int(v[12]),(t/'wchan').read_text().strip()])
  except FileNotFoundError:pass
 print(json.dumps(dict(kind='sample',index=sample,monotonic=time.monotonic(),hz=os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),threads=rows)),flush=True)
 time.sleep(5 if sample==0 else 1)
